company.name: Rydezilla
company.shortDescription: Rydezilla provides a digital platform and mobile app for vehicle rentals and fleet management systems.
company.description: Rydezilla is a Dubai-based mobility technology company specializing in digital car rental solutions, vehicle booking services, and fleet management software. Founded in 2017, the platform enables users to rent cars, motorcycles, and other vehicles through a seamless mobile and web-based experience. Rydezilla also provides SaaS tools for rental companies, including booking automation, fleet tracking, branch management, and customer service support. The company operates primarily in the Middle East and has expanded through partnerships such as its collaboration with Udrive Bahrain to enhance digital car rental accessibility in the region.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $25,000, or 9.09% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,750,000 to $1,646,097, a 0.94x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 44 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 70 (-11).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
